thread:
Maria (CS): Polaris renewal — procurement emailed that they need a PO with an updated billing address and want Net30 instead of Net60. Also flagged pricing credits. Seat count is 120 (80 active). Any blockers from legal/finance?
Raj (AE): @Maria got it. Are we keeping the same rate? They asked to apply the mid-year usage credit and keep the 10% discount. Can we hold price through 03/31?
Anil (RevOps): Net30 for that ARR will need finance signoff. Also procurement is sending a vendor string 'Polaris-OPS' but our system expects 'POL-NA' — mismatch will delay invoice.
Kelsey (Finance): Net30 is fine once we have PO + bank routing. For >$200k we need head-of-finance approval. What is ARR after credits?
Maria (CS): ARR post-credit is $248,700/year. They're proposing a 9mo term. Seats: 120 now, plan to ramp to 150 by month 4.
Lena (Legal): 9mo term + payment-term change = amendment vs new contract. I can draft a short amendment today and set up DocuSign. Any special clauses (data locality, KMS) we need to include?
Raj (AE): No KMS. They did ask that SSO onboarding be scheduled before final signature — can we reference onboarding milestone in the amendment? Also committed to one custom eval set.
Anil (RevOps): For procurement please make sure the PO body includes these exact fields:
``
Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Tax ID: 12-3456789
Vendor code: POL-NA
Currency: USD
```
If the billing entity differs (e.g., Polaris requests us to bill a different Redwood entity) finance will need cross-entity approval.
Kelsey (Finance): :thumbsup: I can approve Net30 once PO contains our billing entity + bank info. Please have procurement email PO to finance@redwood.com so I can triage.
DocuSign-bot: Draft envelope created by Lena (Legal) — envelope id 6312345689. Link: https://docusign.example/ENVELOPE/6312345689
Maria (CS): I'll lock onboarding for week of 2024-04-11 and loop in enablement. Got a verbal from their CFO that they'll sign once PO is in place.
Raj (AE): I'll reach out to the buyer to update vendor code to POL-NA and ask procurement to route to finance. @Kelsey if procurement sends PO today can you try to expedite approval?
Kelsey (Finance): Trying to move it — if we get PO by EOD today I can escalate for same-day approval.
Maria (CS): Closing checklist for thread: 1) PO with correct vendor code and billing entity; 2) amendment in DocuSign; 3) onboarding slot confirmed. I'll update thread once PO lands.
